summary: Preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated 728 KB payload
details: @servicetitan/marketing-route@1.2.3 declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that, on `npm install`, probes for a local `bun` binary and otherwise downloads a Bun release archive from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<platform>.zip`, extracts the `bun` executable to a temp directory, chmods it 0755, and invokes it via `execFileSync(bunPath, [path.join(D, 'math_init.js')], { stdio: 'inherit', cwd: D })`. The sibling file `math_init.js` is a single-line, ~727,680-byte JavaScript blob using a shuffled string-array plus rotator (`WV8StW` cycling table `n7gIxM`) and hex-mangled identifiers, with a `// @bun @bun-cjs` header. The payload is unrelated to the package's advertised purpose (a React routing/store library) and is executed only through the fetched Bun runtime, bypassing Node-reachable code paths. The package name uses the `@servicetitan` scope while `package.json` has an empty `author`, no `repository`, and no metadata tying it to ServiceTitan, consistent with scope impersonation.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
